set.body: Long-lead external input; start now. A-11 / -asc-e2e needs one permitted, redistributable real edf2asc output with known converter options. G2 needs a permitted real memory study that imports without studio code changes. Record license, provenance and digests. Without these two inputs neither the library nor Studio can reach 1.0.
set.title: Obtain permitted real data for 1.0 acceptance: redistributable EDF-derived ASC (A-11) and a real memory study (G2)
